display.purpose: Page-level hero H1/H2 headlines, section H2s, card titles, stat numerals.

body.purpose: All paragraph copy and UI text; the global font-sans default.

label.purpose: Small metadata only (brand names on product cards) - no longer used as a heading kicker.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Default resting elevation for white cards on light sections.

shadows.name: card-hover-glow
shadows.purpose: Interactive card hover - colored glow + lift, not a plain drop shadow.

motion.name: spring-scale
motion.purpose: Small tactile control feedback only (button hover/active) - never for section- or panel-level entrances.

motion.name: confident
motion.purpose: The system's entrance curve: hero cascade, chatbot panel open. Confident arrival, no overshoot. Tailwind token: ease-confident.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA - animated teal-to-cyan-teal gradient with a radial top highlight.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(50.4% 0.084 184.4), oklch(65.4% 0.111 184.1), oklch(77.4% 0.129 207.4)); background-size: 200% 200%; animation: ds-gradient-shift 8s ease infinite; color: #fff; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; padding: 20px 32px; border-radius: 16px; border: none; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.2) 0%, transparent 60%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(65.6% 0.111 184.1); outline-offset: 3px; } @keyframes ds-gradient-shift { 0%, 100% { background-position: 0% 50%; } 50% { background-position: 100% 50%; } }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary CTA - transparent with a teal border, fills solid on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: oklch(65.6% 0.111 184.1); border: 2px solid oklch(65.6% 0.111 184.1); font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; padding: 20px 32px; border-radius: 16px; transition: background 0.3s, color 0.3s, transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(65.6% 0.111 184.1); color: #fff; transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(65.6% 0.111 184.1); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: PowerLink is a family power-and-security business, not a marketplace - the site's job is to feel like a serious, established local company you'd hand your home's electricity to, not a dropshipped storefront. The system is built on a single deep teal, one confident teal accent used everywhere action happens, and a warm copper reserved for the rare energy/solar moment. This is the second confirmed palette for this project: an earlier cyan/purple/pink mix gave way to a navy+blue system, which itself was replaced by this deep-teal+copper system after user feedback that the navy+blue combination felt not attractive. Both prior palettes are confirmed visual rejections. The page rhythm is a deliberate light/dark deck with a varied spacing cadence: the hero and final CTA run generous as high-weight peaks, the FAQ runs tighter as a dense list. Every section heading fuses a small icon badge directly with its H2, centered above the heading text - this replaced an earlier uppercase eyebrow label that sat as a separate line above every heading, now a confirmed rejection. Depth reads differently by background: light sections lean on soft, often colored box-shadows and glassmorphism; dark sections abandon shadows in favor of low-opacity radial glows. Motion is deliberately restrained: decorative floating-particle fields and meaningless icon pulses were removed; the hero is the one authored focal moment with a staggered, confident-deceleration entrance.
keyCharacteristics: One dominant accent (teal) carries all interactive weight; copper is rationed to energy contexts only.
Alternating light/dark full-bleed sections with a deliberately varied spacing cadence, not one repeated interval.
Every section heading pairs an icon badge (centered above) with its H2 - no separate text label precedes a heading anywhere.
Display type (Space Grotesk, self-hosted) carries brand voice on headlines and stat numerals; body copy stays on Inter.
WhatsApp is the one conversion path; its buttons deliberately break the teal system for a green brand color, on purpose.
Motion is purposeful, not ambient: one authored hero entrance, meaningful state feedback, no decorative infinite loops.

rules.name: The One-Hue Rule
rules.body: All interactive color lives in Trust Teal. A new button, link, or icon does not get to introduce its own accent color; it uses --accent-blue (teal) or it uses copper because it is genuinely an energy/solar moment - there is no third option.

rules.name: The WhatsApp Exception
rules.body: Every WhatsApp-facing CTA uses the green-to-emerald gradient instead of the brand system. A non-WhatsApp action (e.g. a native phone dialer link) should not borrow the green either.

rules.name: The Fused-Icon Rule
rules.body: Every major content section pairs a small icon badge with its H2, icon centered above the heading, never a separate uppercase text line preceding it. Replaces the earlier eyebrow-label pattern, now a confirmed rejection.

rules.name: The Alternating Deck Rule
rules.body: No two adjacent full-bleed sections share the same light/dark treatment, and vertical rhythm varies deliberately (peaks at hero/CTA, tighter at the FAQ) rather than repeating one spacing value.

rules.name: The Header-Scale Rule
rules.body: A page header's brand lockup must fit on one to two lines at 375px width; scale logo and type down below the sm breakpoint.

rules.name: The No-Shadow-On-Navy Rule
rules.body: Never apply a box-shadow-based elevation to an element sitting directly on a bg-solar-section/primary-dark background expecting it to be visible - use a radial glow instead.

rules.name: The No-Decorative-Glass Rule
rules.body: .glass-card and .neon-border were removed entirely - every usage sat on a flat or barely-textured background with nothing worth blurring, a confirmed AI-tell. Blur is legitimate only where something busy actually sits behind an element.

rules.name: The One-Gradient-Text Rule
rules.body: Gradient-clip text was scattered across ~13 headings and is now used in exactly one place, the hero's 'Every Need'. Every other heading emphasis is solid text-accent-blue at full weight - size and color carry it, not a clip-text trick.

rules.name: The Primary-Only Magnetic Rule
rules.body: Pointer-attraction hover (useMagnetic) is reserved for the single highest-intent action in a given area - never applied to secondary/outline buttons, nav, or chat controls. It must not be combined with .hover-scale or hover:scale-* on the same element; the hook's inline transform wins the cascade and silently drops the other.

rules.name: The Scroll-Timeline Progressive-Enhancement Rule
rules.body: The hero's ambient orbs drift and scale via animation-timeline: scroll(root) inside @supports (animation-timeline: scroll()). No JS scroll listener. Firefox and older browsers simply keep the orbs static.

dos: Do put every primary CTA through WhatsApp (wa.me/919901893191) with a prefilled, context-specific message.
Do pair every major section heading with an icon badge centered above it - never a separate text eyebrow.
Do alternate light/dark full-bleed section backgrounds with a varied spacing cadence rather than one repeated interval.
Do keep copper rationed to energy/solar contexts; it is a tertiary accent, not a second workhorse color.
Do use a colored glow instead of a shadow for any element sitting on a dark teal background.
Do reserve the springy hover-scale curve for small control feedback; use the confident no-overshoot curve for section- or panel-level entrances.
Do give a page header's brand lockup a smaller variant below sm: so it never wraps past two lines.
Do keep gradient-clip text to the one hero spot; everywhere else use solid color plus weight/size.
Do reserve the magnetic pointer-attraction effect for the single primary CTA in a given area.
donts: Don't introduce a new hue family - the cyan/purple/pink mix and the navy+blue system this one replaced are both confirmed rejections.
Don't reintroduce a text eyebrow label above a heading - fuse an icon with the heading instead.
Don't add decorative, infinitely-looping motion (floating particles, pulsing icons/badges with no state meaning, a repeated SVG grid overlay) - all removed as visual debt.

Don't add or imply real customer testimonials, review counts, or certifications beyond the confirmed '18 years / 1500+ customers' figures - the current three homepage testimonials are explicitly-flagged placeholders.
Don't give WhatsApp buttons the teal treatment, or give a non-WhatsApp button the green treatment.
Don't add backdrop blur as decoration on a flat background - see The No-Decorative-Glass Rule.
Don't rebuild a repeated section as four-or-more identical icon+heading+text cards by reflex - check whether it's actually a sequence first.
Don't combine useMagnetic with .hover-scale or hover:scale-* on the same element.
